claim_limits: Not a full official ToolBench-X score.
Not evidence that TRIAXIS broadly improves intelligence.
Tests one post-execution semantic guard on a trigger-enriched subset.
The free provider endpoint may have service-level limitations and logging policies independent of TRIAXIS.

design.G1: same exact trajectory plus deterministic post-completeness TERMINAL_AUTHORITY guard
design.M0: model-native final answer from the frozen trajectory
design.guard_rule: If and only if the required evidence chain is complete and a successful load-bearing raw tool result contains explicit final_value, final_answer, or canonical_answer, commit the last such explicit terminal value instead of recomposing it with upstream candidates.

objective: Test whether the frozen zero-call TERMINAL_AUTHORITY semantic guard improves exact bounded commitments from a genuinely weaker real model on fresh trigger-targeted native ToolBench-X cases, without changing the model/tool trajectory.

selection.claim_boundary: mechanism-targeted trigger-enriched subset, not representative full ToolBench-X
selection.fresh_disjoint_from: exact v0.7-v0.13 exception task paths; v0.6 conservatively excluded by historical-answer mapping
selection.rank: sha256(PREREG_SHA256 + '|' + exception_path), ascending; first 4 eligible per family

stop_conditions: Any positive or indeterminate monetary cost before or during model calls -> abort remaining requests.
Returned model identifier differs materially from frozen exact model -> abort.
Protocol parameter rejection -> PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE; do not adapt mid-run.
Oracle/final_answer accidentally opened before output freeze -> invalidate run.
After scoring, stop this exact subset; no tweak-and-rerun.
verified_exact_definition: RAW_EXACT AND every required task tool has at least one successful raw execution in the trajectory.
